text:
maya: quick heads-up — ran into inconsistent error shapes across SDKs when a token expires. Python surfaces a typed AuthenticationError with message '401 Unauthorized' and a clear retry hint; Go SDK just returns a generic 403 'forbidden' with no hint. Repro: call /v1/generate with an expired key. Anyone else hit this?

kevin: can you paste a minimal repro + logs?

maya: sure — curl I used: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXPIRED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"hi"}'
```
response from Go SDK (log): ```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-21T15:12:03Z","level":"error","http_status":403,"error":"forbidden: token invalid","request_id":"r-123"}
```
no retry_hint field.

sahil: this rings a bell — our Go auth middleware currently maps some token errors to 403 for legacy reasons (originating from internal policy checks). Python's client layer normalizes gateway 401s into AuthenticationError. So two different normalization layers are at play.

olivia: ugh. For onboarding and sample apps this is confusing — users see different codes across SDKs and wonder whether they should retry or reauth. Can we standardize on a single canonical shape like: ```json
{
  "code":"unauthenticated",
  "http_status": "401",
  "message":"token expired",
  "retry_hint":"reauthenticate"
}
```
and expose a typed exception in all SDKs (e.g., AuthenticationError / ErrUnauthenticated) with machine-readable fields `code` and `retry_hint`?

kevin: +1. Also want a small mapping doc: which http codes map to which SDK exceptions and whether clients should retry automatically. For example: 429 -> RateLimitError (retry after), 503 -> TransientError (retry with backoff), 401/403 -> AuthenticationError (no automatic retry, prompt reauth).

maya: agreed. I'll open a PR to sample-apps to update error handling snippets and add a tests folder that asserts the shape. Also will start PR to go-sdk to change middleware mapping to 401 for token-expiry cases and include `retry_hint`.

sahil: quick note — changing 403->401 mapping could affect some customers relying on 403 semantics. We should add a feature-flagged rollout and a compatibility shim: keep current behavior unless a client opt-in header `X-Error-Shape: canonical` is present. Then we can flip the default after warning period.

olivia: good call. Also add an entry in onboarding docs: code examples showing how to inspect `err.retry_hint` in Python/Go and sample UI copy for showing 'Sign in again' vs 'Try again later'.

maya: created the initial tickets: RD-4521 (sample-apps PR), RD-4522 (go-sdk middleware), RD-4523 (docs + onboarding updates). tagging @devex for visibility. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Ticket RD-4521 created and assigned to maya.

kevin: thanks — once PRs exist we should run quick smoke tests against hosted and dedicated environments to verify status codes and SDK exceptions match.

maya: will do, aiming to have PRs by EOD Fri.

olivia: awesome — thanks!
